designs.name: 余烬·崩阶
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original full-length two-handed fantasy BATTLEAXE, Heteromorphic geometric luminous weapon series, isolated upright on dark charcoal black. Tall portrait, complete weapon with clear margins, no cropping. Near frontal three-quarter view to show strong solid thickness, head in upper third, long straight practical two-handed haft with clear unobstructed lower grip. Bold connected geometric construction, thick broad axe cutting faces, deliberately few major shapes and crisp bevels. Saturated colored energy surfaces and restrained glowing colored outlines, soft controlled halo; no blinding white bloom. Clean opaque energy faces, not realistic metal or crystal, no scratches, marbling, veins, leather, jewels, runes, stars or filigree. Sparse tiny matching geometric particles near head only. Unique dramatic silhouette, polished fantasy game concept art. No text, labels, panels, collage, extra weapon, person, hands, scenery, logo or watermark. Important: recognizable axe, not sword, mace, staff, spear, chainsaw or scythe. Crimson body with coral-red emission. Brutal single broad axe blade on left, its outward cutting silhouette descends through THREE very large stepped chisel teeth, each tooth a broad forward projection with diagonal cutting bevel; solid stepped blade, not many small saw teeth. Upper tooth widest, lower two gradually shorter, creating strong descending staircase profile and chunky angular beard. The head resembles one continuous heavy folded staircase plate joined by a deep broad web to compact rectangular shaft socket. No central hole. Right side a short thick blunt cuboid counterweight. Short broad angular cap, angular faceted heavy flat-ended pommel. Emphasize 3 readable cutting tiers and thick dark-red face with bright bevels. Six small square red sparks.
